Oversees the overall direction and development of BTE Italy.
Responsible for strategic decisions, team coordination, conflict resolution, and ensuring the project progresses efficiently under all aspects (creative, technical, and community-related).

## Moderatore

 Maintains a safe, respectful, and organized Discord environment.
Enforces server rules, assists members, manages reports, and ensures productive communication within the community.

## Tecnico

Manages the technical infrastructure of the project.
Responsible for the development, maintenance, and optimization of:
- The Minecraft server
- Website
- Discord integrations and bots
- Plugins, tools, and related architecture
Ensures stability, performance, and security across all platforms.

## Valutatore

 Reviews and evaluates builders’ work.
Provides constructive feedback, approves completed builds, and determines eligibility for progression to higher building stages or ranks.

## Social

Handles the public image and external communication of BTE Italy.
Manages social media, announcements, promotional content, community engagement, and partnerships to help grow the project and attract new members.

## Gran Maestro

A senior architectural role responsible for coordinating specific large-scale areas or complex projects.
Assigned only when staff determine that dedicated coordination is required.
Oversees planning, ensures stylistic consistency, and supports Architects working within the designated project or region.

## Architetto

Experienced and trusted builders with advanced permissions.
- Can build across the map (including high-responsibility areas, when assigned)
- Access to additional commands and project tools
- May assist with guidance and quality control
Granted by staff based on skill, reliability, and contribution to the project.

## Artigiano

Standard builder rank.
- Can build freely in non-protected areas
- Expected to follow project guidelines and regional standards
Represents full membership in the building team.

## Apprendista

Entry-level builder rank obtained through application.
This is a learning and training stage where members:
- Study BTE standards and building techniques
- Complete a supervised trial build
- Receive feedback from a Valutatore
Promotion to Artigiano is granted after successful evaluation of their trial project.

## Visitor 

A guest rank that grants full access to explore the server, but no building permissions.
Designed for tourists and newcomers who wish to experience and discover the world created by the community.
